title: Order cards & eggs
intro: Choose a pack, pick the themes you love, and send Carole your order in a minute. She’ll confirm what’s available, finish anything made to order, and send you a simple invoice. No payment is taken on this site.
promise_title: What to expect from a handmade piece

promise.title: Drawn and painted by hand, one at a time
promise.text: Every card and egg is made by Carole herself. She could have prints made, but making each piece by hand is where she finds her joy. She sings while she works.

promise.title: No two are exactly alike
promise.text: Even when a design repeats, the wax, the dye and the brush make each one a little different. Colors, lettering and landscapes will vary slightly, and that’s the beauty of it.

promise.title: Photos show the style you’ll receive
promise.text: The pictures are examples of each theme. You’ll get a piece in that style, but usually not that exact one. Pieces marked “On hand” are the actual items, ready to go.

promise.title: Each one carries its own meaning
promise.text: Pysanky are traditionally made with the person who receives them in mind. Every egg comes gift-boxed with Carole’s explanation of the art and its symbols.

how.title: Build your order
how.text: Add singles, mix-and-match packs or bulk packs. Pick themes, or leave it to Carole.

how.title: Send your order
how.text: Checkout creates a purchase order with a number and emails it straight to Carole.

how.title: Carole confirms
how.text: She replies to confirm availability, timing, shipping or pickup, and the final total.

how.title: Pay your way
how.text: She sends payment details (Venmo, PayPal, check or an invoice), then makes and sends your pieces.

payment_note: No card is charged here. Carole confirms every order personally and then sends payment details.

sections.title: Collaged cards
sections.blurb: One-of-a-kind cut-paper and painted cards, blank inside. Mix and match themes in any pack.

sections.title: Pysanky eggs
sections.blurb: Real hen eggs, hand drawn in beeswax and dyed color by color, each gift-boxed with Carole’s guide to the symbols.

sections.title: Bulk & shop packs
sections.blurb: For gift-giving, events, churches and shops. Bulk packs guarantee a good mix of themes and the best per-piece price.

sections.title: On hand now: one-of-a-kind showpieces
sections.blurb: These are the actual pieces pictured, ready to go. Once they’re gone, they’re gone.
